partially_covered.missing: No explicit properties or classes for organization contact details, legal form, or other info beyond address and GLN
No detailed item description, classification, or attributes; only price and quantity covered

cq_coverage.details: Most CQs are covered via InvoiceMessage, Organization, AgentRole, Item, Price, and Section classes. CQ5 and CQ8 lack full detail properties for organizational and item info.

weaknesses: No explicit OWL restrictions or GCAs
Limited use of equivalentClass for complex semantics
No advanced datatype restrictions (e.g., value ranges)

likely_oops_pitfalls: P4: Missing domain or range for some properties (but mostly defined)
P7: Possible lack of explicit class definitions for some referenced entities
reasoner_risks: Hermit and Pellet should succeed; no illegal datatypes or cycles detected
Potential performance issues due to deep hierarchy and many inverse properties

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Expand organization info: Add properties such as hasContactDetail, hasLegalForm, hasVATNumber to Organization to fully answer CQ5
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Complete coverage for organizational information queries

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Expand item info: Add properties such as hasDescription, hasClassification, hasAttribute to Item to fully answer CQ8
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Complete coverage for item information queries

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add OWL restrictions (e.g., cardinality, value constraints) and GCAs for key classes like InvoiceMessage, Item, and Organization
Define equivalentClass axioms for role-based subclasses (e.g., NAD_Buyer ≡ NAD_NameAndAddress and hasRole 'Buyer')
Add custom SKOS concepts for code lists (e.g., country codes, tax types)

summary: The ontology demonstrates strong structural modeling, full OWL 2 compliance, and covers nearly all competency questions. CQ5 and CQ8 are only partially addressed, lacking detailed properties for organizations and items. Quality is high with deep hierarchy and functional properties, but could be improved by adding OWL restrictions and richer equivalence axioms.
